RORK — ANDROID CERTIFICATION / BLOCK 2 OF 3
EXECUTION ONLY

Use the findings from Block 1.

DO NOT:
- perform final platform certification yet
- reopen WebSocket blocker #1
- do unrelated refactoring

GOAL:
Execute the smallest real Android certification path possible.

IF Block 1 found a usable Android execution environment:

1. Build the actual Android app using the existing project configuration.

2. Record:
   - exact build command
   - build variant
   - package/application ID
   - artifact path
   - actual build result

3. Install the app on the verified Android environment.

4. Launch the app.

5. Execute the minimum critical certification path:
   - app launches
   - no immediate crash
   - authentication/startup flow works if applicable
   - backend/API connectivity works
   - primary navigation loads
   - required permissions behave correctly

6. Capture real runtime evidence:
   - device/emulator model
   - Android/API version
   - install result
   - launch result
   - test result
   - relevant runtime/logcat errors

7. If a real IVX defect appears:
   - identify the root cause
   - make only the minimum correction
   - show exact files changed
   - rebuild
   - reinstall
   - rerun the failed check

IF no Android execution environment is available:
Do not simulate or infer PASS.
Return EXTERNAL-BLOCKED.

RETURN ONLY:

<real environment or NONE>
